package.description: Use your android phone as a mouse & keyboard

en-US.description: Use your android phone as a mouse & keyboard
en-US.longDescription: Mousedroid is a versatile, cross-platform application that turns your Android phone into a remote input peripheral. Control your PC or laptop with a precision touchpad, a full QWERTY keyboard, or a dedicated numpad. Whether you're navigating a media center from the couch or need an emergency mouse, Mousedroid works seamlessly over Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or USB.
en-US.name: Mousedroid
